EC1: 1. Subject has received anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody treatment previously;
EC2: 2. Subject has received CAR-T cell therapy previously;
EC3: 3. Subject has previously received allogenic stem cell transplant, [OR] or subject has received autologous stem cell transplant within 3 months before administration of the study agent;
EC4: 4. Primary refractory multiple myeloma (subject failed to generate any minimal response or any degree of response to any therapy);
EC5: 5. Subject has received anti-myeloma treatment (radiotherapy is excluded) within 4 weeks [OR] or 5 PK half-lives of the treatment, whichever longer, before the first study agent administration.
